author: Claude (claude, handoff 146)
status: FROZEN. Committed alone, before any B15N strategy quantity was read.
purpose: Replicate B15L and B15M verbatim on a mechanically closed population drawn from B15i and B15N evidence, so their published findings can be described against a population not censored by a closed recorder.

why_this_exists.the_censoring_being_removed: B15L and B15M ran on cells whose exit checkpoints came from B15f, which schedules from B15a, which B15k measured holding 29% of the launches B15i observes. B15a reached its 5,000-launch stopping rule with extension forbidden, so that fraction is final.
why_this_exists.what_changes: the exit checkpoints come from B15N, which schedules from B15i's own observations. Nothing about either estimand changes.
why_this_exists.what_this_can_and_cannot_settle: it can say whether the published findings look the same on a larger, differently-censored population. It cannot say either version is correct, because both rest on the same arithmetic and the same unreacting-book assumption.

the_closed_population.definition: the FIRST 5,000 distinct launches B15N scheduled, ordered canonically by (t0_slot, signature, mint)
the_closed_population.canonical_order: ascending t0_slot, then ascending signature, then ascending mint; ties broken in that order and no other
the_closed_population.membership_is_mechanical: membership is a function of B15N's schedule table and the ordering above. No launch is selected, excluded or reordered by any property of its curve, its reserves or any outcome.

activation_boundary.note: B15N's own frozen rule admits only launches whose t0_slot is STRICTLY GREATER than the activation slot, so every member is strictly after it by construction rather than by a rule restated here

the_closed_population.size_rationale: the same count B15a's own stopping rule used, chosen so the two populations are the same size and no reader can attribute a difference to one being larger. It is fixed here, before the 5,000th launch exists.
the_closed_population.never_moved_or_shortened: the boundary is 5,000 and the ordering is canonical. Neither is changed, relaxed, or replaced by 'as many as are ready', under any circumstance, ever. A population trimmed to what happened to mature is a population chosen after its outcomes were visible.

closure_gate.fail_closed: the population is LOCKED and nothing is materialized until every condition below holds. Absence of evidence is never treated as closure.
conditions_all_required: B15N's schedule holds at least 5,000 distinct launches at or after the activation boundary
the current finalized slot is at or beyond the LAST deadline of the 5,000th member: its t0_slot plus the maximum entry delay plus the maximum exit horizon plus the frozen 150-slot lateness tolerance
every schedule row belonging to every one of the 5,000 members is terminal: checkpointed, refused or not_scheduled, and none still scheduled
closure_gate.why_all_three: the count alone would materialize before the last horizons were read; the slot alone would materialize while attempts were still in flight; the terminality alone would materialize on a population that is not yet 5,000. Each condition covers a way the other two can be satisfied by an unfinished population.
closure_gate.materialize_exactly_once: once the gate opens the study is materialized once and its output is written once. A second run reports the existing artifact rather than recomputing it, so no output can differ between readings.
closure_gate.reporting_while_locked: the watcher reports the locked state, the members counted so far, and the slots remaining to closure. It reports NO estimand quantity while locked.

inputs.forbidden_enforced_by_source_scan: the module is scanned for those artifact paths and refuses at startup if either appears, because the whole point of the population is that it does not descend from them
inputs.no_network: every quantity is computed from evidence already on disk. If the evidence is insufficient the study refuses rather than fetching more.

b15l.label: COUNTERFACTUAL_UNREACTING_BOOK
unchanged: the UNREACTING_ORDER_FLOW assumption and its statement as false
the eligibility conditions and every refusal code
the exact B9I and B10a arithmetic by direct call
fee schedules decoded from launch transactions and never hardcoded
the prohibition on means, on aggregation across horizons or scenarios, and on calling any output a return

b15m.label: LIQUIDITY_CAPACITY_DIAGNOSTIC
unchanged: the monotonicity requirement and the maximality proof per cell
the curve-resolution floor and the worth-something bound
the differential check against B10b's max_executable_tokens
exact integer order statistics with no mean
the prohibition on selecting, ranking or recommending a size

replicated_verbatim.the_only_change: which artifact supplies the exit checkpoints. Both estimands, both labels, every threshold and every refusal are the published ones.

predeclared_comparison.nature: DESCRIPTIVE ONLY. The replicated figures are placed beside the published V1 figures and the differences are described.
predeclared_comparison.no_pass_threshold_exists: no tolerance, no agreement criterion, no 'replicated successfully' claim and no hypothesis test appears anywhere in this study. A threshold invented now would be a threshold chosen with the V1 numbers already known.
predeclared_comparison.no_pooling: the two populations are never combined, averaged, or presented as one. They are different populations observed through different recorders.

b15l: the count and share of cells for which the naive observed-book exit could be priced at all
the median self-impact in lamports per horizon
the median counterfactual net in lamports per (scenario, horizon, delay)
the count and share of cells at or below zero
b15m: the exact integer order statistics of external liquidity capacity per (horizon, delay)
the liquidity-executable and non-negative counts per grid size per (scenario, horizon, delay)

predeclared_comparison.published_v1_figures_are_read_from_their: research/B15L_COUNTERFACTUAL_FINDING.md and research/B15M_LIQUIDITY_CAPACITY_FINDING.md, so the comparison operand cannot drift
predeclared_comparison.direction_is_not_predicted: this document does not say which way any difference will go. Predicting it would invite reading a confirmed prediction as a validated method.

determinism.row_permutation: the output must be identical under any permutation of the input rows
determinism.membership_permutation: the 5,000 members must be identical under any permutation of B15N's schedule rows
determinism.checked: by computing over shuffled copies and comparing field for field

refusal_codes.meaning: fewer than 5,000 distinct launches exist; the population is not yet drawable
the 5,000th member's last deadline plus tolerance has not passed
a member's schedule row is still scheduled; its outcome is not yet terminal
the study has been materialized; the existing artifact is reported rather than recomputed
a B15a or B15f artifact path appears in the module
an input artifact is missing or unreadable; no network fetch is made to complete it
the drawn membership differed between two computations over the same evidence
a V1 finding document could not be read, so the comparison operand is unavailable

always_publishable: the locked state and slots remaining
both replicated estimands with their own labels
never_publishable: any return, profit or expected value
any pass, fail or agreement verdict
any pooled figure across the two populations
any figure from a locked population
publication.labels_preserved: each replicated estimand keeps its own V1 label, executable=false, landing_probability=unmeasured and competitor_response=unmeasured

strictly_forbidden: wallet or key material of any kind
signing, constructing, simulating or submitting a transaction
reading a B15a or B15f artifact
moving, shortening or relaxing the 5,000-launch boundary
materializing any figure while the population is locked
inventing a pass threshold, an agreement criterion or a verdict
pooling or averaging the two populations
changing any B15L or B15M estimand, threshold, grid, delay, horizon, cost scenario or refusal
touching B11c, B11a, the B15i or B15N workers, their cadence, or any live data
